summary: Frontend-only review of BIOMAP portal body map + Sound Session + cymascope medium regression. All 7 requested checks pass on the live preview. Portal artwork renders (328x408 at 390w; 520x646 at 720w with no horizontal overflow, doc.scrollWidth=720). Node 10 (HEART) and Node 1 (CROWN) select/deselect correctly and the SVG 'SELECTED' tag appears. Sound Session: 432 Hz label, 13s countdown ('STOP · 12s' -> auto-stop in ~13s), AUDIO REACTIVE pill goes active while tone plays, mid-session stop returns to 'START SESSION', and the free-running play/pause toggle works without a countdown. BI-NAURAL tab mounts the same portal and node tap panel. Switching to the DREAM skin (non-default) keeps the portal rendering with no red-screen. Regression: home-lab-execute plays/stops the 432 Hz generator (EXECUTE<->STOP), and the compact home scope medium cycler (opened via home-scope-options) advances through CYMASCOPE -> PLATE -> DISC, each drawing a red-toned pattern with the on-canvas readout '432.x Hz +40 OCT -> 475.x THz . 631 nm' and '= PANTONE WARM RED C' with zero JS console errors. No business-logic or integration fixes were applied; no source files modified.
action_items: No action required for this iteration; all seven requested behaviours verified and no new JS errors observed.

Note (not a bug): on compact home-scope, the medium cycler is only mounted after tapping testID 'home-scope-options'. If future task text wants direct access, consider documenting this expand step or exposing the cycler at the top level.
critical_code_review_comments: PortalFigure.tsx caps the figure at min(measured boxW, 520) via DiagnosticBodyMap.tsx:40 (W clamp), so at 720px foldable the portal centers at 520x646 with no horizontal overflow; confirmed doc.scrollWidth==720.

SoundSession.tsx cleanly separates free-running (start(0)) and timed (setLeft(seconds)) states; subscribeStopAll resets both flags, so a global stop will not leave the start label stuck at 'STOP . Ns'.

DiagnosticBodyMap.tsx reuses the engineMapState mapping so any sounding frequency (including the session's SESSION_TONE_ID=960097) drives excitedNames via pointsForFrequencies; verified during free-running play that AUDIO REACTIVE flips to '. AUDIO REACTIVE'.
ScopeNodePanel.tsx cycleMedium traverses 16 mediums; CYMASCOPE/CHLADNI(rendered as 'PLATE')/DISC each paint the Pantone/THz on-canvas text at 432 Hz with no console errors.

Earlier assumption that 'home-scope-medium-value' is always mounted failed because ScopeNodePanel compact mode initialises optionsOpen=false (ScopeNodePanel.tsx:1273) and gates the cycler block behind {optionsOpen && view === 'SCOPE' && ...} at line 1550.
